messages:
liz: Quick sync — we shipped v1.2 yesterday. Need to split follow-ons: P0/P1 bugs vs quick wins. Who can pair on triage? @maya any urgent CS escalations?

maya: Two customers reporting streaming regressions. Both reproducible with our SDK. Sending logs to #support-attachments. They’re asking for a hotfix — one looks user-facing (P0), one intermittent (P1).

rahul: I can take the P0. If it’s KV cache related, should be a small hotfix. ETA ~2h to triage. I’ll use branch `hotfix/kv-cache-stream-fix`.

jamie: From product: prioritize customer-facing regressions (P0) over QOL enhancements. Also propose a ‘fastlane’ for <=2 dev-day fixes so we don’t bloat hotfixes. Daily cut at 11:00 for fastlane candidates.

toshi: SRE check — infra is stable overall, no cluster-wide spikes. I’ll stand up a canary path if we ship so we don’t blast prod.

deploy-bot: deploy started by @rahul: hotfix/kv-cache-stream-fix -> staging at 1749998920

rahul: Staging shows lower tail latency for the failing trace. Running e2e and synthetic workload now.

liz: Decision for now: P0 hotfix (rahul) for streaming regressions; P1 and small UX fixes go through fastlane next sprint. Action items: rahul = triage + canary, jamie = document fastlane rules, maya = collect customer SLIs and owners, toshi = monitor canary.

jamie: I’ll write the fastlane doc and post link here. Proposed criteria: <=2 dev-days, no infra schema changes, automated rollback documented.

maya: Uploaded CS notes and repro steps (internal link). Customer ids x123 / x987. Both requested ETA <48h.

rahul: Canary looks good: 15m with the failing trace, zero errors in ~18k requests. Promoting to 50% for additional confidence.

deploy-bot: promote completed -> 50% at 1749998950

toshi: :thumbsup: Monitoring dashboards configured. Alert if error rate >0.5% over a 5m window.

liz: Nice work — we’ll update the customers and close the loop. Schedule a 30m postmortem tomorrow 10:00 to capture root cause, mitigation, and guardrails for future regressions.

maya: I’ll draft the customer update and loop in legal/CS where needed.

jamie: Adding a backlog ticket now that links the PRs and includes acceptance criteria to prevent regression (tests + perf guardrails).

rahul: Will follow up with PR link once merged.

liz: Thanks everyone — keep updates here.
